channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Rip-Off Britain
channel.desc: The team investigate how the 1990s fashion for bamboo in our gardens is causing expensive problems for some homeowners 25 years later and what can be done to stop the plant from running riot under your property. And the man who narrowly escaped injury when the glass roof of his conservatory shattered. Who should foot the bill with the installer out of business?
